common.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.restricted: Access is limited to approved accounts.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: You are signed in as {email}, but this account may not use the dashboard. Sign out, then sign in with an account that may.
noAccess.bodyNoEmail: This account may not use the dashboard. Sign out, then sign in with an account that may.

metaTitle.label: Meta title
metaTitle.hint: Shown as the headline in search results. Leave blank to use the title above.

metaDescription.label: Meta description
metaDescription.hint: The grey summary under the search result. Around 150 characters reads best.

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
validation.url: Enter a full web address, starting with https://
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (e.g. kitchen-operations).
validation.youtube: Must be a youtube.com or youtu.be link.
validation.link: Use a page path like /ka/projects, a section like #inquiry, or a full https://, mailto: or tel: link.
validation.seatsLeftOverTotal: Seats left can't be more than the seats in total.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.slugTaken: Another item already uses this link. Choose a different one.
errors.conflict: This clashes with something that already exists.
errors.unsupportedType: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images can be uploaded.
errors.badRequest: The request could not be processed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reasons.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email or password is incorrect. Run `pnpm setup:check` to check the account, or `pnpm admin:set-password` to set a known one.
reasons.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: This account exists but its email is not confirmed. Tick "Auto Confirm User" when creating it, or run `pnpm admin:set-password`.
reasons.AUTH_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the sign-in service. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, contact whoever maintains the site.
reasons.AUTH_MISCONFIGURED: The authentication service rejected the request path, which means NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is wrong. It must be the bare origin, https://PROJECT-REF.supabase.co, with no /rest/v1 or other path. Run `pnpm setup:check`.
reasons.NOT_ALLOWED: This account is not permitted to use the dashboard.
reasons.RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
reasons.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: Supabase is throttling sign-in attempts. Wait a minute.
reasons.MEDIA_IN_USE: This image is still used by other content. Remove it there first, then delete it here.
reasons.STALE_REFERENCE: Something this links to no longer exists (deleted meanwhile, perhaps). Reload the page and choose again.

errors.uploadStalled: The upload stopped making progress, so it was cancelled. Check the connection and try again. If it keeps happening, uploads are being blocked: contact whoever maintains the site.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Edits here appear on the public site as soon as you save.
dashboard.countsFailed: The counts could not be loaded. Every other screen works as usual; try refreshing the page.
dashboard.newInquiries: {count, plural, one {# new inquiry waiting} other {# new inquiries waiting}}

addProject.label: Add a case study
addProject.description: Publish a new project with its photos.

writeArticle.label: Write an article
writeArticle.description: Add a post to Insights, with or without a named author.

addCourse.label: Add a course
addCourse.description: Put a new Academy course on the site, with its date, seats and price.

editPages.label: Edit page copy
editPages.description: Change the words on Home, About and the rest without a deploy.

companyStats.label: Company in figures
companyStats.description: The figures under the home page's first section: years, projects and more.

settings.label: Site settings
settings.description: Logo, contact details, default SEO and the inquiry inbox.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHint: Basic HTML is allowed; scripts are stripped on save.

slug.label: Slug
slug.hint: The end of the page's web address, e.g. the kitchen-renovation in stager.ge/ka/projects/kitchen-renovation. Lowercase Latin letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it later breaks links people already have.
slug.autoFromTitle: While you create it, this fills in from the English title. You can still change it.
slug.autoFromName: While you create it, this fills in from the English name. You can still change it.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Case studies shown on the public site.
projects.emptyDescription: Add your first case study to show it on the site.

form.description: A card in the Projects section of the home page: its photos, its name and details, and a short summary that shows when a visitor points at it. Projects have no page of their own.
form.slugHint: The project's name inside the site, never shown: projects have no page, so no link uses it. Lowercase Latin letters, numbers and hyphens.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: One or two sentences. Shown over the photos when a visitor points at the card; on a phone, under its name.

form.mediaDescription: The card shows the cover first, then the photos below in this order, one at a time: visitors move through them with the arrows, or swipe on a phone.
form.coverHint: The first photo on the card, and the picture shown when the site is shared.

featured.label: Featured
featured.hint: Featured projects are listed before the rest.

services.title: Services
services.description: Which service lines this project demonstrates.

excerpt.label: Excerpt
excerpt.hint: Shown on the Insights list and in search results.

showAuthor.label: Show the author on the article
showAuthor.hint: Turn this off to publish without naming anyone. The author is then hidden from the API too, not just the page.

form.coverHint: Also used as the social sharing image unless one is set per language.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Used to file articles under Insights.
categories.emptyDescription: Articles can be published without one.
categories.deleteLinked: {count, plural, one {# article uses this category and will be left without one.} other {# articles use this category and will be left without one.}}

services.title: Services
services.description: The service lines listed on the site. Add or edit them without a deploy.

icon.label: Icon key
icon.hint: Matches an icon component in the codebase. Leave blank for none.

services.deleteLinked: {count, plural, one {# project or course links to this service and will lose the link.} other {# projects and courses link to this service and will lose the link.}}

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: STAGER Academy courses. A course leaves the site by itself once its start date has passed.
courses.datePassed: Date passed: not on the site

summary.label: Short description
summary.hint: Shown with the course on the site.

duration.label: Duration
duration.hint: As it should read on the site, e.g. 4 weeks or 6 Saturdays.

location.label: Location
location.hint: Leave blank for an online course.

startsAt.label: Start date
startsAt.hint: The course shows on the site up to and including this day. Leave blank if the next date is not set yet.

seatsTotal.label: Seats in total
seatsTotal.hint: Leave blank to not show seats.

seatsLeft.label: Seats left
seatsLeft.hint: Registrations arrive as inquiries, so update this by hand. 0 shows the course as full.

price.label: Price (₾)
price.hint: Whole lari. Leave blank for a free course.

category.label: Category
category.hint: Groups courses on the site. Add categories under Course categories.

courseCategories.title: Course categories
courseCategories.description: Group the courses on the site. Separate from the categories of blog articles.
courseCategories.emptyDescription: A course can be published without one.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Videos from STAGER's YouTube channel, newest first.

summary.label: Short description
summary.hint: Shown with the video on the site.

youtube.label: YouTube link
youtube.hint: The video plays from YouTube. You can save it without a link and add one later.

publishedAt.label: Date
publishedAt.hint: When it came out. The newest video is shown first.

team.title: Team
team.deleteLinked: {count, plural, one {# article names this person as its author and will show no author.} other {# articles name this person as their author and will show no author.}}

alt.label: Describe the image (alt text)
alt.hint: In a few words, what the photo shows. Screen readers read it aloud to blind visitors, search engines use it, and it appears in place of the photo if the photo does not load.

media.title: Media
media.description: Every image used on the site. Alt text is what a screen reader announces.
media.altPlaceholder: e.g. Chef plating a dish during service
media.altFirst: Add alt text before choosing a file — it cannot be filled in properly later.

mediaPicker.altRequired: Alt text is required before uploading.
mediaPicker.empty: No images yet. Upload the first one above.

gallery.libraryEmpty: No images yet. Upload one from the cover image field or the Media screen.

pages.title: Page copy
pages.description: Change the words and SEO on each page. The sections themselves are fixed in code.

pageEditor.title: {page} page
pageEditor.description: Edit the copy and SEO. Sections cannot be added or removed here — they are part of the layout.
pageEditor.heading: Heading

buttonLink.label: Button link
buttonLink.hint: Where the button leads: a page on this site, like /contact, or a full address starting with https://.

companyStats.title: Company in figures
companyStats.description: The figures under the first section of the home page: years of experience, projects delivered and the like. Until you add one, the site shows sample figures marked “Sample”.

value.label: Figure
value.hint: Up to 12 characters, such as 20+, 150 or 1,200. The site counts up to the number.

companyStats.emptyDescription: Four read best: a figure and a short caption each.

socialLinks.title: Social links
socialLinks.description: Shown in the footer. Turn one off instead of deleting it if the account is only paused.

label.label: Label
label.hint: Optional. Falls back to the platform name.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.description: Logo, contact details and the defaults used across the site.

logoLight.label: Light logo
logoLight.hint: Used on the dark teal background.

inquiryInbox.label: Inquiry inbox
inquiryInbox.hint: Where contact-form messages are sent. Leave blank to use the address configured in the environment.

errorReporting.title: Error reporting
errorReporting.description: Errors on the site and in the dashboard are sent to Sentry, where whoever maintains the site sees them. Send a test error to check that it works.
errorReporting.sent: Sent. It should appear in Sentry within a minute.
errorReporting.off: Error reporting is off: no Sentry address is set for this site. Whoever maintains the site can turn it on.

inquiries.title: Inquiries
inquiries.description: Messages from the contact form. These are also emailed to the inquiry inbox.
inquiries.emptyDescription: Submissions from the Start a Project form will appear here.
inquiries.notNotified: The notification email could not be sent for this one — reply directly.
inquiries.archivedEmptyDescription: Archive moves an inquiry here, out of the inbox; Restore brings it back.

email.subject: New inquiry — {name}
email.heading: New project inquiry
email.name: Name
email.replyHint: Reply directly to this email to reach the sender.
